Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Pager: high error rate detected in tokyo-inference-region (tokyo-1). Alert: 5xx spike + latency increase.
Alex: seeing spikes in 500s from tokyo pool, tail latency 2s -> 12s. dashboards: https://internal.redwood/status/TOKYO-INC-91
Maria: confirmed. A subset of requests are hitting backend variant B (new canary). Rate ~18% of tokyo traffic.
Sanjay: oncall here. impact: hosted-api customers and some Dedicated tenants in apac. RMSE of requests failing ~22/min.
Alex: deploy-bot: "canary swap started" posted ~2m ago. logs show TLS handshake timeouts to b-variants.
Lisa: looks like DNS at edge is returning mixed A records: some nodes still resolving old pool, some new. TTLs were set to 300s but our CDN cached older entries.
Oncall Pager: initiating mitigation — will pause route for tokyo canary. executing: `/feature-flag set geo-routing/tokyo canary=false --actor=oncall`
Sanjay: ack. Maria, can you confirm flag toggle command?
Maria: running now. output: `{
